meta_description: Mario Plumbing & Electrical offers expert plumbing and electrical services across Nottingham. Fast response, quality workmanship, free quotes. Call us today.
hero_subhead: Leaks, faults, or full installations — we respond fast and fix it right the first time.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Electrical Services Across Nottingham
services_subhead: From emergency callouts to planned installations, we cover every plumbing and electrical need for homes and businesses throughout Nottingham.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing
services.desc: Burst pipes, sudden leaks, or blocked drains — we respond quickly to protect your home from further damage. Available across Nottingham with a fast callout response.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Servicing
services.desc: Keep your home warm and your energy bills in check with a professionally installed or serviced boiler. We work with all major boiler brands and recommend the best solution for your property.

services.title: Bathroom Installation
services.desc: Full bathroom fitting from start to finish, including tiling, pipework, and all plumbing connections. We leave you with a clean, functional bathroom you'll love for years to come.

services.title: Leak Detection & Repair
services.desc: Hidden leaks can cause serious structural damage if left unchecked. We use proven diagnostic methods to locate and repair leaks quickly, minimising disruption to your home.

services.title: Electrical Installations & Rewiring
services.desc: Whether you need a full rewire, extra sockets, or a consumer unit upgrade, our qualified electricians carry out every job to Part P regulations. Safe, tested, and certificated on completion.

services.title: Drain Unblocking & Maintenance
services.desc: Slow drains and blockages are no match for our professional equipment. We clear blockages efficiently and offer maintenance plans to keep your drains flowing freely.

about_pullquote: Every job, big or small, gets the same care and attention to detail.
about_para_1: Mario Plumbing & Electrical has been serving homeowners and businesses across Nottingham for over a decade. Founded on the belief that local trades should be trustworthy, transparent, and genuinely helpful, the business has grown entirely through word-of-mouth and repeat custom.
about_para_2: We take pride in arriving on time, communicating clearly, and leaving every property cleaner than we found it. Our customers return to us because they know they'll receive honest advice, quality workmanship, and a fair price — every single time.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Mario came out the same day we called about a burst pipe under the kitchen sink. Sorted it quickly, no mess left behind, and the price was very reasonable. Couldn't have asked for better service.
reviews.author: Karen T.

reviews.text: Had Mario fit a new bathroom for us last autumn. From the initial quote through to the final tidy-up, everything was handled professionally. The quality of the work is excellent and we've had so many compliments on it.
reviews.author: David S.

reviews.text: Called about a tripping consumer unit and Mario was round within a couple of hours. Diagnosed the fault straight away, explained everything clearly, and had it fixed before the end of the day. Brilliant service.
reviews.author: Priya M.
